---
title: "Null distributions: an interactive simulation"
toc: false
page-layout: full
---

The null-hypothesis-testing notebook gave us one observed quality-control
sample:

$$
n = 25,
\qquad
\bar{X}=20.20\text{ mm},
\qquad
S=0.40\text{ mm}.
$$

We want to know where that one observed sample mean would stand if the null
claim ($H_0: \mu = 20.00\ \text{mm}$) were true. Choose a null population below, then
generate many hypothetical samples of 25 shafts. The resulting distribution of
sample means is the null distribution for this test.

The Normal and Uniform models have different shapes for individual shaft
diameters, but their displayed parameters give both models the same null mean
and population SD. The simulation does not estimate these parameters; it takes
them as the specified null model.

::: {.callout-tip}
## What to watch

The dashed line marks the null mean, 20.00 mm, and the solid red line marks
the observed mean, 20.20 mm. First build the null distribution and assess how
unusual the observation looks. Then use **Show rejection region** to reveal
the two-sided decision rule for a chosen $\alpha$. The simulation estimates the
two-sided p-value by counting sample means at least as extreme as the
observation.
:::

```{=html}
<div id="null-test-explorer" class="clt-explorer" aria-label="Null distribution hypothesis-testing simulation">
  <div class="clt-controls">
    <label>
      Null population model
      <select id="null-test-distribution">
        <option value="normal">Normal</option>
        <option value="uniform">Uniform</option>
      </select>
    </label>
    <label>
      <span>Total trials, <i>B</i> (1,000–10,000)</span>
      <input id="null-test-total-trials" type="number" min="1000" max="10000" step="1" value="5000" inputmode="numeric">
    </label>
    <label>
      Add trials
      <select id="null-test-batch-size">
        <option value="1">1</option>
        <option value="5">5</option>
        <option value="25" selected>25</option>
        <option value="100">100</option>
        <option value="250">250</option>
      </select>
    </label>
    <label id="null-test-alpha-control" hidden>
      <span>Significance level, <i>α</i></span>
      <select id="null-test-alpha">
        <option value="0.10">0.10</option>
        <option value="0.05" selected>0.05</option>
        <option value="0.01">0.01</option>
      </select>
    </label>
  </div>

  <p class="null-test-summary"><strong>Observed sample:</strong>
    <span class="math inline">\(n = 25\)</span>;
    <span class="math inline">\(\bar{X} = 20.20\ \text{mm}\)</span>;
    <span class="math inline">\(S = 0.40\ \text{mm}\)</span>.</p>

  <div id="null-test-summary" class="null-test-summary" aria-live="polite"></div>

  <div class="clt-buttons" aria-label="Simulation controls">
    <button id="null-test-add" type="button">Add trials</button>
    <button id="null-test-run" type="button">Run remaining trials</button>
    <button id="null-test-reveal" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Show rejection region</button>
    <button id="null-test-reset" type="button">Reset</button>
  </div>

  <p id="null-test-status" class="clt-status" aria-live="polite">No trials yet. Add a small batch to begin.</p>

  <figure class="clt-plot null-test-plot">
    <figcaption>Null distribution of sample means <span id="null-test-critical-legend" class="clt-legend" hidden><span class="null-test-critical-swatch"></span><span id="null-test-critical-legend-text">two-sided critical region</span></span></figcaption>
    <svg id="null-test-sample-means" role="img" aria-label="Accumulating null distribution of sample means"></svg>
  </figure>

  <p id="null-test-decision" class="null-test-decision" aria-live="polite" hidden></p>
</div>
```

With a Normal population, the sample mean is exactly Normal. With a Uniform
population, the sample mean is only approximately Normal—but with 25
observations, the central limit theorem makes the two null distributions look
similar.

<a href="index.qmd">← Return to Foundations</a>

<script>
(() => {
  const root = document.getElementById("null-test-explorer");
  if (!root) return;

  const sampleSize = 25;
  const observedMean = 20.20;
  const observedSampleSd = 0.40;
  const nullMean = 20.00;
  const nullPopulationSd = 0.40;
  const observedDistance = Math.abs(observedMean - nullMean);
  const uniformLower = nullMean - Math.sqrt(3) * nullPopulationSd;
  const uniformUpper = nullMean + Math.sqrt(3) * nullPopulationSd;

  const distributionInput = document.getElementById("null-test-distribution");
  const totalTrialsInput = document.getElementById("null-test-total-trials");
  const batchSizeInput = document.getElementById("null-test-batch-size");
  const alphaControl = document.getElementById("null-test-alpha-control");
  const alphaInput = document.getElementById("null-test-alpha");
  const addButton = document.getElementById("null-test-add");
  const runButton = document.getElementById("null-test-run");
  const revealButton = document.getElementById("null-test-reveal");
  const resetButton = document.getElementById("null-test-reset");
  const summary = document.getElementById("null-test-summary");
  const status = document.getElementById("null-test-status");
  const criticalLegend = document.getElementById("null-test-critical-legend");
  const criticalLegendText = document.getElementById("null-test-critical-legend-text");
  const decision = document.getElementById("null-test-decision");

  let means = [];
  let showRejectionRegion = false;

  const clamp = (value, lower, upper) => Math.max(lower, Math.min(upper, value));
  const getTotalTrials = () => clamp(Number.parseInt(totalTrialsInput.value, 10) || 5000, 1000, 10000);
  const getAlpha = () => Number.parseFloat(alphaInput.value);

  function criticalValues() {
    const alpha = getAlpha();
    const criticalZ = { 0.10: 1.6449, 0.05: 1.9600, 0.01: 2.5758 }[alpha];
    const criticalDistance = criticalZ * nullPopulationSd / Math.sqrt(sampleSize);
    return {
      alpha,
      lower: nullMean - criticalDistance,
      upper: nullMean + criticalDistance
    };
  }

  function normalRandom() {
    const u = 1 - Math.random();
    const v = Math.random();
    return Math.sqrt(-2 * Math.log(u)) * Math.cos(2 * Math.PI * v);
  }

  function activeModel() {
    if (distributionInput.value === "uniform") {
      return {
        name: "Uniform",
        parameters: `Uniform population: lower bound = ${uniformLower.toFixed(3)} mm; upper bound = ${uniformUpper.toFixed(3)} mm`,
        draw: () => uniformLower + Math.random() * (uniformUpper - uniformLower)
      };
    }
    return {
      name: "Normal",
      parameters: "Normal population: mean = 20.00 mm; SD = 0.40 mm",
      draw: () => nullMean + nullPopulationSd * normalRandom()
    };
  }

  function svgElement(tag, attributes = {}) {
    const element = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", tag);
    Object.entries(attributes).forEach(([key, value]) => element.setAttribute(key, value));
    return element;
  }

  function addText(svg, text, x, y, attributes = {}) {
    const element = svgElement("text", { x, y, ...attributes });
    element.textContent = text;
    svg.append(element);
  }

  function prepareSvg() {
    const svg = document.getElementById("null-test-sample-means");
    const width = Math.max(320, Math.round(svg.getBoundingClientRect().width || 920));
    const height = 300;
    svg.replaceChildren();
    svg.setAttribute("viewBox", `0 0 ${width} ${height}`);
    svg.setAttribute("preserveAspectRatio", "none");
    return { svg, width, height, margin: { top: 20, right: 22, bottom: 40, left: 48 } };
  }

  function addAxes(chart, domain, maximum) {
    const { svg, width, height, margin } = chart;
    const plotWidth = width - margin.left - margin.right;
    const plotHeight = height - margin.top - margin.bottom;
    const x = value => margin.left + ((value - domain[0]) / (domain[1] - domain[0])) * plotWidth;
    const y = value => margin.top + plotHeight - (value / maximum) * plotHeight;

    svg.append(svgElement("line", { x1: margin.left, y1: y(0), x2: width - margin.right, y2: y(0), class: "clt-axis" }));
    svg.append(svgElement("line", { x1: margin.left, y1: margin.top, x2: margin.left, y2: y(0), class: "clt-axis" }));
    for (let i = 0; i <= 4; i += 1) {
      const value = domain[0] + (i / 4) * (domain[1] - domain[0]);
      const tickX = x(value);
      svg.append(svgElement("line", { x1: tickX, y1: y(0), x2: tickX, y2: y(0) + 4, class: "clt-axis" }));
      addText(svg, value.toFixed(2), tickX, height - 14, { class: "clt-tick", "text-anchor": "middle" });
    }
    const labelX = 14;
    const labelY = margin.top + plotHeight / 2;
    addText(svg, "simulated samples", labelX, labelY, {
      class: "clt-tick",
      "text-anchor": "middle",
      transform: `rotate(-90 ${labelX} ${labelY})`
    });
    return { x, y };
  }

  function histogram(values, domain, binCount) {
    const bins = Array.from({ length: binCount }, () => 0);
    const width = (domain[1] - domain[0]) / binCount;
    values.forEach(value => {
      const index = clamp(Math.floor((value - domain[0]) / width), 0, binCount - 1);
      bins[index] += 1;
    });
    return { bins, width };
  }

  function drawNullDistribution() {
    const chart = prepareSvg();
    const standardError = nullPopulationSd / Math.sqrt(sampleSize);
    const { lower: lowerCritical, upper: upperCritical } = criticalValues();
    const observedSpread = means.length ? Math.max(...means.map(mean => Math.abs(mean - nullMean))) : 0;
    const spread = Math.max(4 * standardError, observedDistance * 1.35, observedSpread * 1.12);
    const domain = [nullMean - spread, nullMean + spread];
    const binCount = 64;
    const { bins, width: binWidth } = histogram(means, domain, binCount);
    const maximum = Math.max(...bins, 1) * 1.12;
    const { svg, width, height, margin } = chart;
    const { x, y } = addAxes(chart, domain, maximum);

    if (showRejectionRegion) {
      [
        [domain[0], lowerCritical],
        [upperCritical, domain[1]]
      ].forEach(([start, end]) => {
        svg.append(svgElement("rect", {
          x: x(start),
          y: margin.top,
          width: Math.max(0, x(end) - x(start)),
          height: y(0) - margin.top,
          class: "null-test-critical-region"
        }));
      });
    }

    bins.forEach((count, index) => {
      const start = domain[0] + index * binWidth;
      const attributes = {
        x: x(start) + 1,
        y: y(count),
        width: Math.max(1, x(start + binWidth) - x(start) - 2),
        height: y(0) - y(count),
        class: "clt-means-bar"
      };
      svg.append(svgElement("rect", attributes));
    });

    const nullX = x(nullMean);
    svg.append(svgElement("line", { x1: nullX, y1: margin.top, x2: nullX, y2: y(0), class: "clt-mean-line" }));
    addText(svg, "null mean: 20.00", Math.min(nullX + 4, width - 95), margin.top + 13, { class: "clt-annotation" });

    if (showRejectionRegion) {
      [lowerCritical, upperCritical].forEach(cutoff => {
        const cutoffX = x(cutoff);
        svg.append(svgElement("line", { x1: cutoffX, y1: margin.top, x2: cutoffX, y2: y(0), class: "null-test-critical-boundary" }));
      });
    }

    const observedX = x(observedMean);
    svg.append(svgElement("line", { x1: observedX, y1: margin.top, x2: observedX, y2: y(0), class: "null-test-observed-line" }));
    addText(svg, "observed mean: 20.20", Math.min(observedX + 4, width - 125), margin.top + 13, { class: "clt-annotation" });

    if (!means.length) {
      addText(svg, "The simulated null distribution will appear here.", width / 2, height / 2, {
        class: "clt-empty-message", "text-anchor": "middle"
      });
    }
  }

  function addTrials(requested) {
    const total = getTotalTrials();
    const numberToAdd = Math.min(requested, Math.max(0, total - means.length));
    const model = activeModel();
    for (let trial = 0; trial < numberToAdd; trial += 1) {
      let sum = 0;
      for (let observation = 0; observation < sampleSize; observation += 1) sum += model.draw();
      means.push(sum / sampleSize);
    }
    render();
  }

  function render() {
    const model = activeModel();
    const total = getTotalTrials();
    const completed = means.length;
    const remaining = total - completed;
    const extremeCount = means.filter(mean => Math.abs(mean - nullMean) >= observedDistance).length;
    summary.innerHTML = `<p><strong>Selected null model:</strong> ${model.parameters}.</p>`;
    const { alpha, lower, upper } = criticalValues();
    const rejects = observedMean < lower || observedMean > upper;
    alphaControl.hidden = !showRejectionRegion;
    criticalLegend.hidden = !showRejectionRegion;
    criticalLegendText.textContent = `two-sided critical region, α = ${alpha.toFixed(2)}`;
    decision.hidden = !showRejectionRegion;
    if (showRejectionRegion) {
      const typeIError = `${(alpha * 100).toFixed(0)}%`;
      decision.innerHTML = rejects
        ? `<strong>Decision:</strong> With a Type-I error rate of ${typeIError}, we <strong>reject</strong> H<sub>0</sub>: the sample provides evidence that the process mean differs from 20.00 mm.`
        : `<strong>Decision:</strong> With a Type-I error rate of ${typeIError}, we <strong>fail to reject</strong> H<sub>0</sub>: the sample does not provide sufficient evidence that the process mean differs from 20.00 mm.`;
    }
    drawNullDistribution();
    status.textContent = completed
      ? `${completed} of ${total} null samples completed. ${extremeCount} are at least as extreme as the observation (estimated two-sided p-value: ${(extremeCount / completed).toFixed(3)}).`
      : "No trials yet. Add a small batch to begin.";
    addButton.disabled = remaining <= 0;
    runButton.disabled = remaining <= 0;
  }

  function reset() {
    totalTrialsInput.value = getTotalTrials();
    means = [];
    render();
  }

  addButton.addEventListener("click", () => addTrials(Number.parseInt(batchSizeInput.value, 10)));
  runButton.addEventListener("click", () => addTrials(getTotalTrials() - means.length));
  revealButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
    showRejectionRegion = !showRejectionRegion;
    revealButton.textContent = showRejectionRegion ? "Hide rejection region" : "Show rejection region";
    revealButton.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(showRejectionRegion));
    render();
  });
  resetButton.addEventListener("click", reset);
  [distributionInput, totalTrialsInput].forEach(input => input.addEventListener("change", reset));
  alphaInput.addEventListener("change", render);
  window.addEventListener("resize", render);
  reset();
})();
</script>
